content.value_statement: Creative coding often needs structure before it becomes usable art. This skill guides Claude, Codex, and Claude Code to build seeded p5.js artworks with templates, controls, and repeatable variations.
actual_capabilities: Creates an algorithmic philosophy before writing the artwork implementation.
Uses p5.js patterns for seeded randomness and reproducible visual variations.
Starts from a provided viewer template with fixed layout and seed controls.
Defines interactive parameter controls for sliders, colors, and regeneration actions.
Produces a single HTML artifact intended to run in a browser or Claude artifact view.
Includes guidance for variation exploration through seed navigation and presets.
limitations: Generated HTML may load p5.js and fonts from external CDNs unless bundled manually.
The skill gives implementation guidance but does not include an automated renderer or test runner.
Visual quality still depends on the model following the philosophy and tuning parameters well.
It is designed for original algorithmic art, not copying named artists or protected styles.

use_cases.title: Prototype Exhibition Sketches
use_cases.description: Create browser-based generative art studies with seed controls and adjustable parameters for review.

use_cases.title: Teach Creative Coding
use_cases.description: Generate structured p5.js examples that show seeded randomness, parameters, and emergent visual systems.

use_cases.title: Explore Branded Visual Systems
use_cases.description: Turn an abstract concept into repeatable visual variations for campaigns, presentations, or product visuals.

prompt_templates.title: Start a Simple Sketch
prompt_templates.scenario: Beginner request for one complete interactive artwork.
prompt_templates.prompt: Create an original algorithmic art piece about slow ocean currents. Include the philosophy and a single p5.js HTML artifact with seed controls.

prompt_templates.title: Add Tunable Controls
prompt_templates.scenario: User wants more control over the generated artwork.
prompt_templates.prompt: Create generative art based on urban light trails. Add sliders for density, flow speed, trail length, and turbulence. Keep the output reproducible by seed.

prompt_templates.title: Create a Variation System
prompt_templates.scenario: User needs multiple curated outputs from one algorithm.
prompt_templates.prompt: Design an algorithmic artwork about crystalline growth. Include seed navigation and identify five strong seed presets with short visual descriptions.

prompt_templates.title: Build a Refined Conceptual Piece
prompt_templates.scenario: Advanced request with a conceptual brief and production constraints.
prompt_templates.prompt: Create a gallery-quality p5.js generative artwork for the concept of memory erosion. Use an original algorithm, restrained color controls, deterministic seeds, and performance-conscious animation.

output_examples.input: Create generative art inspired by migrating stars.
output_examples.output: The skill produces a short algorithmic philosophy, then an interactive p5.js artwork with particle motion, seed controls, and adjustable parameters.

output_examples.input: Make 100 variations of a flow field artwork.
output_examples.output: The skill guides creation of one repeatable algorithm with seed navigation, then uses seeds 1 through 100 as the variation space.

output_examples.input: Create an abstract brand background with warm colors.
output_examples.output: The skill translates the brief into a generative system with palette controls, reproducible output, and a single browser-ready artifact.

best_practices: Start with a clear concept so the algorithm has a defined visual purpose.
Keep every random choice tied to a seed for reproducible review and sharing.
Tune parameters for visual range, performance, and predictable user interaction.
anti_patterns: Do not copy a named artist or ask for protected style imitation.
Do not replace the template layout unless the user explicitly requests a different interface.
Do not rely on random visual noise without structure, constraints, or composition.

faq.question: What does this skill create?
faq.answer: It creates original p5.js generative art with a written concept, seeded randomness, and interactive controls.

faq.question: Can the same artwork be reproduced?
faq.answer: Yes. The workflow requires seeded randomness so the same seed can recreate the same result.

faq.question: Does it require a server?
faq.answer: No. The intended output is a single HTML artifact that opens in a browser or Claude artifact view.

faq.question: Does it use external network resources?
faq.answer: The included template loads p5.js and fonts from public CDNs unless the output is modified to bundle them locally.

faq.question: Can it make many variations?
faq.answer: Yes. Seed controls let users browse variations and create curated seed presets.

faq.question: Is it meant for copying existing art styles?
faq.answer: No. The skill explicitly focuses on original algorithmic art and avoids copying existing artists.
